props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction. Mirrors the ARIA name.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a busy state and blocks interaction.

props.name: type
props.description: `submit`, `reset`, or `button`. Native semantics, so a Button inside a form behaves like the `<button>` a consumer would have written by hand.

props.name: form
props.description: The `id` of a `<form>` element to associate this element with.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the element, used when submitting an HTML form.

ai.summary: Triggers an action: submit a form, open a dialog, save a change.
whenToUse: The control performs an action on the current page
It submits or resets a form
It opens a panel, dialog, or menu
whenNotToUse: It navigates somewhere — use a Link instead
It toggles a value on its own, with no action — use a Checkbox or Switch
It is the only option in a set — use a Radio Group
ai.accessibility: Button role. Activates on Enter and Space. A loading button is aria-busy rather than disabled, so it keeps its accessible name and position in the tab order.
knownLimitations: As a form-associated custom element, `type="submit"` calls form.requestSubmit() explicitly; native implicit submission does not apply
